parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating fan blade assembly made of ABS plastic, typically found in a cooling fan. It consists of multiple curved blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to generate airflow, cooling electronic components or circulating air within a system.
parts.Movement_description: This part rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor located in the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the fan, made of ABS plastic. It provides structural support and houses the motor and mounting points.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the fan blades and motor in place, ensuring stability and proper alignment during operation.
parts.Movement_description: This part remains stationary and does not move during operation.
